articles.title: Xsolla推出发行工具，在首次购买后保持玩家“参与度”
articles.summary: Xsolla推出新的发行工具套件，帮助PC游戏工作室在玩家首次购买后通过自建社区中心、实时运营模板和通知系统维持参与度，并获取一手玩家数据。此举旨在减少对Steam等第三方平台的依赖，提升直接销售和复购率，对关注用户留存与DTC模式的团队有参考价值。
articles.translated_content:
标题：Xsolla推出发行工具，在首次购买后保持玩家“参与度”

正文：
Xsolla推出一系列工具，在玩家首次购买后保持其“参与度”
商业
新闻
Xsolla推出发行工具，在玩家首次购买后保持其“参与度”
这家商业公司希望为工作室提供更多推动重复购买的方式。
Diego Argüello
，新闻副编辑
，
GameDeveloper.com
2026年8月13日
2分钟阅读
图片来自Xsolla
商业公司Xsolla为其发行套件推出了一系列新工具，旨在为开发者提供更多方式，让玩家在游戏内首次购买后保持参与度。
该工具于今日早些时候通过新闻稿发布，主要围绕PC游戏工作室在游戏内购后加强与玩家之间的关系。工作室基于该发行套件建立的直营渠道，将与其已在售游戏的平台（如Steam和Epic Games Store）并行运营。
Xsolla表示，这些工具应能带来更好的利润率、第一方玩家数据，以及工作室对其自有变现日程表的更直接掌控。为实现这些目标，这些工具包括一个社区中心——这是一个由工作室拥有的“参与空间”，超越传统商店界面和Discord等应用。该中心可以展示新闻、任务、用户生成内容和推荐，所有玩家数据均归工作室所有。
相关：
Saber Interactive将在公众争议后添加Rideshare“Stimulator”AI披露声明
此外，还有实时运营活动模板，以无代码模板的形式推出，可直接在商店中运行季节性活动和限时优惠。工作室现在还可以拥有专门的皮肤、服装和其他外观商品的商品化展示体验，以及将视频作为插图，使用游戏片段和预告片作为产品页面媒体，取代静态图片。
最后，Xsolla Launcher中现在有一个通知系统，用于发布补丁说明、活动和优惠，无需第三方渠道即可集中通信，同时为“实时服务型和高级PC电子游戏工作室”提供自助式设置，标准集成无需自定义工程。
“商店界面将游戏呈现在玩家面前，但它们并未给予工作室与玩家的直接关系，”Xsolla总裁Chris Hewish在公告中表示。“此次发布关乎首次销售之后发生的事。新的商店、社区中心和启动器工具为PC游戏工作室提供了自己的渠道，让他们按照自己的时间表保持玩家参与度，并获取随之而来的玩家数据。”
去年，Xsolla推出了一个SDK，为使用Unity开发的开发者提供直接面向消费者的变现选项，继续围绕该模式的战略布局。2024年10月，Hewish与EMEA高级副总裁Chris Meredith共同对“守门人”进行了长篇批评，指出对开发者而言，这是一个“异常拥挤的市场”。两人未点名任何具体案例或商店平台，而是谈到了通过允许开发者直接向玩家进行数字销售来实现“游戏业务民主化”的理念。
相关：
CD Projekt Red已裁掉九名Project Sirius开发者
“对我们来说，在与将产品推向市场的广告商保持关系的同时，我们非常清楚要努力让他们走上[直接面向消费者]的路线图，而如果你是一个三人小团队开发者，那相当具有挑战性，”Meredith当时表示。
你可以在官方网站上了解更多关于新发行工具的信息。

Xsolla rolls out tools to keep players 'engaged' after a purchase
Business
News
Xsolla rolls out publishing tools to keep players 'engaged' after the first purchase
The commerce company wants to give studios more ways to drive repeat purchases.
Diego Argüello
,
Contributing Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 13, 2026
2 Min Read
Image via Xsolla
Commerce company Xsolla has rolled out a new slate of tools for its publishing suite, all aimed at granting developers more ways to keep players engaged after the first purchase in their games.
Announced earlier today via a press release, the tools are centered around PC game studios strengthening the relationship with players after an in-game purchase. As such, the studio's direct channel built on the publishing suite runs alongside the platforms they already sell on, such as Steam and the Epic Games Store.
Xsolla says these tools should lead to better margins, first-party player data, and overall more direct control over a studio's own monetization calendar. In order to achieve these goals, the tools include a community hub, which is a studio-owned "engagement space" beyond traditional storefronts and apps like Discord. The hub can display news, quests, user-generated content, and referrals, with all player data staying with the studio.
Related:
Saber Interactive to add Rideshare 'Stimulator' AI disclosure after public controversy
Then, there's the live ops event template, introduced as a no-code template to run seasonal events and limited-time offers directly in the store. Studios can now also have dedicated merchandising experience for skins, outfits, and other cosmetics, as well as video as illustrations, using gameplay clips and trailers a product-page media instead of static images.
Lastly, there's now a notification system within the Xsolla Launcher for patch notes, events, and offers, centralizing communications without the need for third-party channels, as well as a self-service setup for "live-service and premium PC video game studios" with no custom engineering for standard integration.
"Storefronts put a game in front of players, yet they do not give a studio a direct relationship with them," Xsolla president Chris Hewish said in the announcement. "This release is about what happens after the first sale. The new store, Community Hub, and launcher tools give PC game studios their own channel to keep players engaged, on their own schedule, with the player data that comes from it."
Last year, Xsolla
launched an SDK
that enables direct-to-consumer monetization options for developers working on Unity, continuing its strategy efforts around the model. In October of 2024, Hewish, alongside senior VP of EMEA Chris Meredith,
spoke at length against
"gatekeepers," noting that it's an "awfully congested market" for developers. Without mentioning any specific examples or storefronts, the pair spoke about the idea of "democratizing the business of gaming" by allowing devs to sell digitally to players directly.
Related:
CD Projekt Red has laid off nine Project Sirius developers
"For us, with the relationship with the advertisers bringing their products to market, we are very much aware of trying to put them on the track of the [direct-to-consumer] roadmap, and if you're a small three man developer, that's quite challenging," Meredith said at the time.
You can learn more information about the new publishing tools over at the
official site
.

articles.summary: Supercell的怪物狩猎游戏Mo Co在重启后仍表现不佳，团队承认玩法循环易使玩家流失，但强调游戏仍在迭代，关停可能性较低。对从业者而言，该案例展示了游戏未能找到市场定位时，重启与长线调优也是可行路径，但需警惕小众化与规模化之间的张力。

articles.translated_content:
标题：Mo Co表现不佳将再次重启，但Supercell称“不太可能”关停

正文：
Mo Co表现不佳将再次重启——但Supercell称关停它“不太可能”——Mobilegamer.biz
跳至内容
Supercell已就其怪物狩猎游戏Mo Co在最近一次重启后表现不佳一事，提出了关停该游戏的可能性——但这家芬兰公司表示，完全关闭游戏“仍然是不太可能的情况”。
在这款怪物狩猎游戏实际上重新发布三个月后，开发团队向玩家更新了进展：“mo.co的表现不如我们预期，”博客中写道。
“虽然某些方面，比如新武器和玩法改动很有前景，但游戏循环对大多数玩家来说很快就会变得乏味，导致他们流失。另一方面，留下来的玩家平均游戏时长异常高。这表明mo.co对一个小众群体来说运行得相当不错，但尚未准备好规模化扩展。”
接下来游戏还会有进一步改动，这将对下一赛季造成干扰，很可能也会影响到再下一个赛季。
博客继续写道：“你们可能想知道这款游戏的未来。它会被关停吗？这仍然是不太可能的情况。我们有很多令人兴奋的想法，而且我们完全相信mo.co的潜力。然而，我们需要对外界公开透明地说明这种可能性。”
“一款仍在试图在市场中找到自己定位的游戏，总是面临被停运的风险。目前，这不在我们的计划中，而且只要我们团队仍然相信这款我们满怀热情的游戏拥有巨大潜力，这种情况就会持续下去。”
Supercell于2025年3月推出Mo Co，其设定颇为不同寻常：玩家必须获得创作者或Supercell本身的邀请才能游玩该游戏。
几个月后的7月，Mo Co向所有人开放，但未能像Supercell旗下大多数其他游戏那样火爆。
在Squad Busters关停后不久，这家《部落冲突》开发商坚称，虽然Mo Co作为一款Supercell游戏收入相对较低，但它不会被关闭，而是会进行大规模改革。重启版本于今年5月上线。
AppMagic数据显示，自2025年3月发布以来，Mo Co已从900万次下载中赚取约670万美元，大部分收入来自美国（26%）、日本（12%）、德国（8%）、法国（7%）和韩国（5%）。在收入方面，Mo Co的表现明显低于在发布一年多后就被关停的Squad Busters。

articles.original_content:
Mo Co is underperforming and will be rebooted (again) – but Supercell says killing it is “unlikely” – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Supercell has floated the possibility of killing its monster hunting game Mo Co after a recent reboot underperformed – but closing the game entirely “remains an unlikely scenario,” says the Finnish firm.
Three months after the monster hunting game was effectively relaunched, the development team has updated players on how it’s going: “mo.co is not performing as well as we hoped,”
the blog reads
.
“While some aspects, such as the new weapons and gameplay changes are promising, the gameplay loop quickly gets stale for most of our players, leading them to drop off. On the other hand, the average gameplay time for those who
are
staying is unusually high. This shows that mo.co is working quite well for a niche, but it’s not yet ready to scale up.”
There will now be further changes to the game which will disrupt the next season, and likely the one after that.
The blog continues: “You may be wondering about the future of the game. Could it be killed? That still remains an unlikely scenario. We have lots of ideas we’re excited about, and we fully believe in mo.co’s potential. However, we need to be open and transparent about the possibility.”
“A game still trying to find its place in the market is always at risk of being discontinued. For the moment, it’s not in our plan, and that will continue to be the case while we, as a team, believe in the incredible potential of this game we’re so passionate about.”
Supercell launched Mo Co in March 2025
with an unusual premise: players had to receive an invite from a creator or from Supercell itself to play the game.
Mo Co was opened up for all to play
a few months later in July, but has failed to catch fire in the same way most of Supercell’s other games have.
Shortly after the closure of Squad Busters, the Clash of Clans maker insisted that while it is earning relatively little for a Supercell game,
Mo Co is not closing, but is getting a big overhaul
. The
reboot went live in May of this year
.
AppMagic data
suggests that since launch in March 2025, Mo Co has earned around $6.7m from 9m downloads, with most revenue coming from the US (26%), Japan (12%), Germany (8%), France (7%) and South Korea (5%). In terms of revenue Mo Co is tracking dramatically below
Squad Busters, which was killed a little over a year after launch.

Netflix is closing Oxenfree developer Night School Studio and Helsinki-based Moonloot, the company confirmed Thursday.
A Netflix representative told Game Developer that the company is also "eliminating some additional games roles" across the games team. Netflix declined to share details on how many people were laid off.
Game File
first reported the news of the two studios' closures.
Night School Studio released horror game
Unhinged
in late June, just weeks before Thursday's closure.
Unhinged
is played on a browser or television, and the player uses their personal smartphone as a controller. Zoë Kravitz (The Batman), Sadie Sink (Spider-Man: Brand New Day), and Troy Baker (
Marvel Rivals
) all voiced characters for the game. Moonloot did not have any announced projects, but was
reportedly working on some sort of Animal Crossing-like game
. Night School Studio released its award-winning
Oxenfree
in 2016 before Netflix published its sequel,
Oxenfree 2: Lost Signals
.
Netflix acquired Night School Studio in 2021
, shortly after Netflix officially launched its games business. It was the first studio to be acquired by the streaming platform. Moonloot was spun up internally at Netflix in 2022.
Related:
Xsolla rolls out publishing tools to keep players 'engaged' after the first purchase
"Games continue to be an opportunity for us to expand the variety of entertainment we offer Netflix members, and we've built solid foundations in our key focus areas," the Netflix representative said. "As we continue to prioritize these areas, we see an opportunity to be more focused in our execution, so we are making organizational changes to the business to match those priorities."
Netflix is "excited," the spokesperson said, "about the momentum" of cloud and kids games. The news release listed several "key focus areas," like kids games, party games, narrative games, and mainstream games. (
Unhinged
, from now-closed Night School Studio, is listed as a narrative example.) Netflix recently released party and sports games
Netflix Minigolf
and
FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition
.
FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition
developer Refactor Games (which is an external studio)
laid off 85% of its employees
just weeks after the game was released.
Netflix has been shifting its games strategy to these sorts of casual or party games for people to play together on a television, rather than exclusively on their smartphones. (
At launch in 2021
, Netflix seemed more interested in mobile games.) Netflix has spent the last few years shutting down most of the studios it acquired:
Team Blue
, reportedly working on a first-person game, was shut down in 2024; Boss Fight Entertainment, which made
Squid Game: Unleashed
,
was shuttered in October 2025
; Cozy Grove developer Spry Fox
split from Netflix in December
. Co-founders Daniel Cook and David Edery bought back the company from Netflix.
Netflix Mini Golf
maker Next Games is the only studio left, aside from Netflix's internal games team.
Related:
Saber Interactive to add Rideshare 'Stimulator' AI disclosure after public controversy
Its latest announcement is a partnership with Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games; an
"extended look" trailer for
Grand Theft Auto 6
will debut on Netflix. It's exclusive to Netflix for six hours.
Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy
(packaging up three Grand Theft Auto games)
came to mobile via Netflix in 2023
.
At least five studios across the video game industry laid off workers in just a couple weeks of August. That includes CD Projekt Red, That's No Moon, Supermassive Games, Lightspeed, and Refactor Games.

Mattel has announced the formation of Mattel Game Studios, a global development organisation that will create games based on the company's IP. It follows the company's
February acquisition of 100% of Mattel163
, a joint venture that was previously 50% owned by partner firm NetEase.
Mattel Games Studios counts a staff of "nearly 300 artists, designers, engineers, live operations specialists, and producers across Los Angeles and Hangzhou," the company said in a press release. It will oversee the company's existing mobile games, upcoming free-to-play titles and releases on game platforms like Roblox and Fortnite, and sit within the Mattel Digital Studios organisation which oversees licenced releases.
The existing portfolio built up by Mattel163 includes mobile releases UNO!, UNO Wonder, Phase 10, and Skip-Bo, which have racked up over 550 million downloads worldwide and have approximately 20 million monthly active players, the company said.
The first title from the new Marvel Game Studios was endless runner Skeletor: Until Next Time!, based on the Masters of the Universe IP, which released in June. The studio is currently working on new releases UNO Wild, currently in soft launch, and an unnamed Hot Wheels title.
The company's push into owned and operated titles follows the huge success of rival toy firm Hasbro, which has seen massive revenues from games like Monopoly Go and Baldur's Gate 3.
“Mattel Game Studios gives us the scale and capabilities to build and publish more original gaming experiences inspired by our iconic brands," said Marcus Liassides, Senior Vice President and Global Head of Mattel Digital Studios. "Together with our successful collaborations across the industry, it strengthens our ability to reach fans through great games wherever they choose to play.”

Publisher and developer Saber Interactive is promising to update the Steam Page of its recently-announced game
Rideshare "Stimulator"
with an AI disclosure after defending itself from claims that it and developer Unigine replaced writers with generative AI.
A Saber Interactive spokesperson confirmed the news to Game Developer after we inquired about claims made by veteran game writer Stella Sacco, who posted on Bluesky about their experience working as a lead writer on
Rideshare "Stimulator."
Rideshare
will use AI technology in an "experimental free-ride mode" that incorporates AI "by necessity," as the game generates an infinite number of passengers for players to haul from one location to the next.
"The Steam page will be updated once the feature set is finalized," the spokesperson said. "We are touting this experimental mode as a feature, not shying away from it."
According to Sacco
, she had been working as a lead writer on
Rideshare
but was "replaced with ChatGPT midway through development."
Related:
CD Projekt Red has laid off nine Project Sirius developers
"All the passenger voices were AI too," she added. "Either they changed direction at some point or they’re not disclosing it on Steam." She provided a
contemporaneous Facebook screenshot
documenting when she first said she had been replaced by ChatGPT in the workplace from 2023 to support her claim.
Saber denies that this took place. "Neither Saber nor Unigine have replaced any writers with AI for
Rideshare
or any other game," a company spokesperson said in a statement to Game Developer. They added that Saber's writing staff has "tripled" since 2023, when Sacco made her Facebook post, saying the game's story was "written entirely by real people."
"We are firm believers in using AI tools to improve or enhance gameplay experiences and improve NPC behavior as we have done since Saber was founded in 2001," the spokesperson said. "As the industry has continued to contract, Saber continues to hire. None of our 3000+ employees have to worry about being replaced by AI."
Saber's denial comes in the wake of growing developer discontent over the use of generative AI technology in game development, with an increasing number of industry professionals believing the technology will have
a negative impact of the industry
and
have a harmful effect
on the quality of games.
In follow-up posts on Bluesky, Sacco said the directive to use generative AI on
Rideshare
came from CEO Matt Karch, who made waves this week when he confirmed that the trailer for
Rideshare "Stimulator"
contains a joke license plate making fun of Gearbox CEO Randy Pitchford. "The dig is because Randy took shots at Embracer in
Borderlands 4
,” Saber CEO Matt Karch said in a comment to
Game File
. "Without Embracer, Randy is performing magic tricks at birthday parties for a living."
Related:

Karch has spent the last few years
defending
Embracer Group chairman and former CEO Lars Wingefors from what he says is unfair criticism. Sacco said she warned Karch that at the time, she warned Karch that players would push back on generative AI use in
Rideshare
.
He further stoked the flames of controversy in comments made to
This Week In Video Games
where he made numerous disparaging comments about his former employee.
Sacco posted her own response to
Karch on Bluesky
, where she reiterated that all of her claims about the company were "true." "I’m comfortable with what I said, and everyone got to see what kind of man is running Saber," she concluded.

数字情报公司Sensor Tower报告称，GTA6的预购订单中有89%选择的是100美元的终极版，而非80美元的标准版。
该游戏两个发售平台的预购比例相近，Xbox买家中有90%选择终极版，而PlayStation平台这一比例为88.5%。
这些数据印证了Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick近期在接受CNBC采访时所言，预购订单“更偏向高级版”。但预购订单向终极版倾斜的程度之大，甚至令Sensor Tower视频游戏情报部门高级副总裁兼总经理Karl Kontus感到惊讶。

GTA6终极版中包含Stock 305服装店｜图片来源：Rockstar Games

他向GamesIndustry.biz指出，特别版“在预购期间往往表现优异”，因为游戏的预购者往往是其最忠实的粉丝，而这类玩家也更倾向于购买高级版。“话虽如此，我从未见过90%的高级版占比，”他表示，“预购期间50%的高级版占比已经是非常出色的数字了。游戏的高级版占比通常维持在10%到20%左右。”
他预计，随着更多休闲玩家购买游戏，GTA6终极版的销售占比将随时间下降，“但很可能仍会显著高于行业标准。”
Kontus认为，在发售时，80美元标准版与100美元终极版之间的销售比例，将在很大程度上取决于GTA6的营销机器能在发售日前吸引多少休闲玩家。

“我从未见过90%的高级版占比”

“绝大部分营销活动尚未启动，大多数预购订单将在发售前最后一周左右涌入，”他说，“我预计届时的比例将更接近50/50。话虽如此，GTA6的预测难度极大，因为它处于一个自成一档的水平。从目前来看，这款游戏的表现没有任何可参照的基准。”
至于终极版为何表现如此出色，Kontus认为定价在其中起了很大作用。“80美元（已经高于我们目前看到的70美元行业标准）与100美元之间的差距并不大，而且100美元的SKU附带了大量额外内容。”终极版包含一系列独家福利，包括车辆改装店的访问权限。

“有时高级版SKU只是为了抬高价格而填充内容，但GTA6的高级版SKU附带了大量的载具、武器，甚至还有你无法通过其他途径获得的定制改装店，”Kontus表示，“对很多人来说，这是今年必买的游戏，他们希望充分体验它。我其实有点惊讶他们没有推出150美元的SKU——感觉像是把钱留在了桌上（不过这样也不会有那么多玩家感到不满）。”

独眼威利改装店的访问权限是GTA6终极版附带的福利之一｜图片来源：Rockstar Games

至于GTA6在发售时总共能卖出多少套，Kontus表示很难预测。“如果我们采用任何‘正常’的预购轨迹，目前400万份预购订单意味着到发售时将达到4000万份以上。然而，正如Strauss Zelnick本人在最近一次采访中指出的，对GTA6来说什么样的数字才算‘正常’极难判断。围绕这款游戏的热度实在太高了，以至于一切都随之扭曲。”
Zelnick最近告诉GamesIndustry.biz，预购订单的水平“前所未有且令人惊叹”，但“正因为它们如此前所未有，我们真的不知道这将如何转化为实际销量。”
Kontus推测预购订单相当前置集中，这意味着实际数字将远低于4000万，且“实际预购数字可能更接近2500万左右”，他表示即便如此，这仍将是“前所未有的预购表现”。

“作为对比，《赛博朋克2077》在发售时公布了800万份预购订单，”他说，“2500万份预购意味着游戏正式发售时销售额约为20亿美元——立即覆盖其开发成本，可能还包括绝大部分营销费用。”
Sensor Tower创建了一个GTA6销售追踪器，目前显示该游戏的预购次数已达430万次，其中PlayStation平台占预购量的77%，Xbox平台占23%。
在GTA6于6月开启预购之前，GamesIndustry.biz曾询问多位分析师对GTA6首年销量的看法。预估范围从3000万至3500万套到超过5000万套不等，Enders Analysis的Gareth Sutcliffe表示，“爆发式销售情景”下该游戏甚至可能逼近6000万套。

Sensor Tower: 89% of GTA6 preorders are for the $100 ultimate edition | GamesIndustry.biz

.
The digital intelligence firm Sensor Tower reports that 89% of preorders for GTA6 are for the $100 ultimate edition rather than the $80 standard edition.
The percentages are similar for both of the game's launch platforms, with 90% of buyers on Xbox plumping for the ultimate edition, compared with 88.5% on PlayStation.
The figures back up Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick's recent statement in an
interview with CNBC
that preorders are "skewing more to the premium edition." But just how much more they are skewing towards the ultimate edition came as a surprise to Karl Kontus, SVP and GM of Video Game Insights at Sensor Tower.
The Stock 305 Clothing Store is included in the ultimate edition of GTA6  |
Image credit:
Rockstar Games
He points out to
GamesIndustry.biz
that special editions "always tend to perform well during the preorder period," because games tend to be preordered by their most dedicated fans, who are also more likely to want a premium edition. "That being said, I have never seen a 90% premium share before," he says. "A 50% premium share during preorders is a great number. Typical premium shares for games tend to be at around 10–20%."
He expects the share of sales for the GTA6 ultimate edition to decline over time as more casual players buy the game, "but it's likely it'll stay significantly above the industry standard."
Kontus thinks that at launch, the split between the $80 standard edition and the $100 ultimate edition will largely be determined by how many casual players the GTA6 marketing machine can pull in ahead of the release date.
"I have never seen a 90% premium share before"
"The vast majority of the marketing campaign hasn't kicked off yet, and most of the preorders will come in the last week or so pre-launch," he says. "I expect the split for these to be much closer to 50/50. That being said, GTA6 is very hard to forecast, given it lives in a league of its own. There is no benchmark for how this game will perform from here."
As for why the ultimate edition is performing so well, Kontus thinks the pricing has a lot to do with it. "The difference between $80 (already higher than the industry standard $70 we see today) and $100 isn't that big, and the $100 SKU comes with a lot of additional content." The ultimate edition includes a
long list of exclusive perks
, including access to vehicle customisation shops.
"Sometimes the premium SKUs are just filler content to justify a higher price, but the GTA6 premium SKU comes with a meaningful amount of vehicles, weapons, and even a custom mod shop that you wouldn't get otherwise," says Kontus. "For a lot of people, this is the one 'must buy' game this year, and they will want to make the most of it. I'm actually kind of surprised they didn't do a $150 SKU – feels like money left on the table (but also fewer players being angry as a result)."
Access to One-Eyed Willie’s Mod Shop is one of the perks that comes with the GTA6 ultimate edition  |
Image credit:
Rockstar Games
In terms of just how many units GTA6 will sell in total at launch, Kontus says it's difficult to predict. "If we used any 'normal' preorder trajectories, the current 4 million preorders would mean 40 million+ preorders by launch. However, as Strauss Zelnick himself pointed out
in a recent interview
, it's incredibly hard to say what's 'normal' for GTA6. The zeitgeist around the game is so high that it warps everything."
Zelnick
recently told
GamesIndustry.biz
that the level of pre-orders was "unprecedented and astonishing" but that "they are also so unprecedented that we just don't know how it'll translate into sales."
Kontus suspects that the preorders are fairly frontloaded, meaning they will fall well short of the 40 million mark, and that "actual preorders might land more in the 25 million ballpark," which he says would still be "an unprecedented preorder performance."
"For comparison, Cyberpunk 2077 announced 8 million preorders by launch," he says. "25 million preorder units would mean circa $2 billion in sales by the time the game actually launches – immediately paying for its development cost and probably for the vast majority of the marketing as well."
Sensor Tower has created a
GTA6 sales tracker
, which currently shows the game has been preordered 4.3 million times, with 77% of preorders on PlayStation versus 23% on Xbox.
Ahead of the launch of preorders for GTA6 in June,
GamesIndustry.biz
asked a range of analysts for their thoughts on how many units GTA6 would sell in its first year.
The estimates ranged from 30-35 million to over 50 million units
, with Gareth Sutcliffe of Enders Analysis suggesting that a "blow out sales scenario" could even see the game closing in on 60 million sales.

Liftoff Mobile发布了自6月上市以来的首份财报，第二季度营收为2.2亿美元。

这意味着营收同比增长35%，环比增长7%——这是该公司连续第11个季度实现营收增长。

核心广告收入几乎占Liftoff全部业务，达到2.19亿美元，同比增长36%。调整后EBITDA为1.32亿美元，利润率为60%——高于去年同期的53%——因为营收增长快于成本。

首席执行官Jeremy Bondy将本季度业绩归功于公司的Cortex机器学习平台，并表示：“更好的广告表现让客户有理由增加在我们平台上的支出。”

Liftoff于6月5日完成IPO，募资4.724亿美元。它用部分收益偿还了4.184亿美元债务，截至6月30日，长期债务为13.9亿美元，现金及等价物为3.054亿美元。

对于第三季度，Liftoff预计营收为2.17亿至2.22亿美元，调整后EBITDA为1.24亿至1.28亿美元；全年营收指引为8.7亿至8.8亿美元，调整后EBITDA为5.1亿至5.18亿美元，这意味着利润率约为59%。

财报发布后，公司股价盘后下跌3.7%。

Liftoff在2025年净亏损2310万美元，营收6.857亿美元，而去年同期净亏损4820万美元，营收5.193亿美元。

标题：CD Projekt RED裁掉九名Project Sirius开发者

正文：

CD Projekt Red已裁掉九名Project Sirius开发者
两个办公地点共有九人被裁，另有九名开发者可能被调往其他项目。
Nicole Carpenter
，专栏作家
，Game Developer

图片来自CD Projekt
《巫师》和《赛博朋克》的开发商CD Projekt Red已裁掉九名员工。
据Kotaku首次报道，所有受影响的员工似乎都在参与一款代号为Project Sirius的《巫师》多人游戏。另有九人被邀请申请不同项目的职位。
CD Projekt Red的一位代表向Game Developer确认，波士顿有四人、波兰有五人被裁。该代表写道，另外九人"已被邀请参与CD Projekt Red其他项目潜在职位的内部招聘流程"。
"我们调整了Sirius团队的规模，以反映项目在当前开发阶段的需求，"他们补充道。
截至2026年6月，CD Projekt Red在全球拥有超过1300名员工。其开发中心位于华沙和波士顿，在加拿大和欧洲设有办事处。Project Sirius于2022年公布，此前总部位于波士顿的The Molasses Flood于2021年被CD Projekt收购。
相关：
Saber Interactive在公众争议后将为Rideshare 'Stimulator'添加AI披露声明
去年，CD Projekt Red确认The Molasses Flood（以《洪潮之焰》闻名）已被吸收合并，不再作为独立实体运营。公众对Project Sirius几乎一无所知，只知道这家波士顿工作室一直在主导该项目。目前尚不清楚情况是否仍然如此。
2023年，CD Projekt Red裁掉了29名开发者——美国21人，波兰8人——据Kotaku 2023年的报道，此前Project Sirius据称"发生了改变"。CD Projekt Red在2023年5月的监管公告中表示，正在为该项目实施"新框架"，并因此计提了700万美元的减值。
那些裁员使这家波士顿工作室规模相对缩小。根据一份季度报告，截至2026年2月，有71名开发者在参与Project Sirius。团队随后再次扩大，根据同一份季度报告，截至2026年4月30日，有83人在参与该游戏。公司中有更大一部分人——513人——正在参与《巫师4》。
今天的裁员使Project Sirius的开发团队缩减至大约65人。
Kotaku周三报道称，尽管该项目自公布以来一直举步维艰，但"最近进展相对顺利"。5月份，《命运2》的叙事设计师Kwan Perng宣布，他现在担任Project Sirius的首席编剧。
"我需要一段时间才能谈论这个项目，但与此同时，我一直沉浸在《巫师》黑暗而多元的宇宙中，"Perng在5月份的LinkedIn帖子中写道。"能有机会在这个世界中、与如此有才华的开发者们一起讲述故事，令我感到十分荣幸。"

Image via CD Projekt
Nine people have been laid off by The Witcher
and
Cyberpunk developer CD Projekt Red.
As first reported by Kotaku
, all of the impacted employees were seemingly working on an upcoming Witcher multiplayer game codenamed Project Sirius. Another nine have been invited to apply for roles on different projects.
A CD Projekt Red representative confirmed to Game Developer that four people in Boston and five in Poland have been laid off. Nine other people "have been invited to internal recruitment processes for potential roles on other CD Projekt Red projects," the representative wrote.
"We adjusted the size of the Sirius team to reflect the project's needs at this stage of development," they added.
As of June 2026, CD Projekt Red
employed more than 1,300 people
around the globe. Its development hubs are located in Warsaw and Boston, with offices in Canada and Europe. Project Sirius was announced in 2022 after
Boston-based The Molasses Flood was acquired by CD Projekt in 2021
.
Related:
Saber Interactive to add Rideshare 'Stimulator' AI disclosure after public controversy
Last year, CD Projekt Red confirmed The Molasses Flood (known for
The Flame in the Flood
)
had been absorbed
and is no longer operating as an independent entity. There's nearly nothing known publicly about Project Sirius, except that the Boston-based studio had been heading it up. It's unclear whether that's still the case.
In 2023,
CD Projekt Red laid off 29 developers
—21 in the U.S. and eight in Poland,
per Kotaku's 2023 report
—after Project Sirius reportedly "changed." CD Projekt Red
said in a regulatory announcement
in May 2023 that it was implementing a "new framework" for the project, and recorded a $7 million write-down as a result.
Those layoffs would have left the Boston-based studio relatively small. By February 2026, 71 developers were working on Project Sirius,
per a quarterly report
. The team scaled up again, and had 83 people working on the game as of April 30, 2026, according to that same quarterly report. A much larger portion of the company—513 people—are working on
The Witcher 4
.
The layoffs today bring Project Sirius' development team back down to roughly 65.
Kotaku reported Wednesday that, while the project has struggled since its announcement, it was moving along "relatively well recently." In May,
Destiny 2
narrative designer Kwan Perng announced that he is now working
as lead writer on Project Sirius
.
"It will be some time before I can talk about the project, but in the meantime I've been immersing myself in the dark and eclectic universe of The Witcher,"
Perng wrote in a post on LinkedIn
in May. "It's humbling to get the opportunity to tell stories in this world and in the company of such talented developers."

开发者预计生成式AI将在未来三年对游戏行业产生最大影响，波及部分岗位的团队规模和生产力。

这一结论来自Gamescom Dev Speaker调查，该调查收集了今年大会100位演讲者的回答。总体而言，83%的受访者预计AI将在某种程度上影响团队结构或生产力。

Developers expect generative AI to impact roles and team sizes in the next three years
A survey taken by 100 speakers at this year's Gamescom Dev Conference showcases hesitation and mixed feelings on generative AI use.
Diego Argüello

August 12, 2026

Image via 11 Bit Studios
Developers are expecting generative AI (genAI) to have its biggest impact on the game industry over the next three years, affecting team sizes and productivity for certain roles.
This comes from the Gamescom Dev Speaker survey, which collects answers from 100 speakers from this year's conference. Overall, 83 percent of respondents expect AI to affect team structure or productivity in some way.
When it comes to specifics, the respondents are largely split on the tech, which has garnered a
largely negative reception from developers
in recent years, with many arguing that it is having a corrosive effect on the industry. 36 percent of the speakers believe AI will change roles rather than reduce teams, while 33 percent expect smaller team sizes. 17 percent do not expect AI to reduce teams, and only 14 percent anticipate increased output per person
Respondents also chimed in on its current use. 34 percent see the greatest value of AI in areas like code and production, while 30 percent prefer as little AI involvement in game development as possible. As noted by the survey, the result remains broadly consistent with
last year's questionnaire
.
Related:
Saber Interactive to add Rideshare 'Stimulator' AI disclosure after public controversy
As for other areas where AI is currently being used, management and administration tasks sit at at 12 percent, quality assurance and testing and "other answers" at 7 percent each, art and animation at 4 percent, localization at 3 percent, marketing and communication at 2 percent, and narrative design at 1 percent.
The survey results come amidst studios
continuing to toot the genAI horn
. Companies like
Capcom
and
Owlcat Games
claim to be using genAI to speed up production and iterate faster on their games, respectively. Meanwhile, studios like
Pearl Abyss
, known for
Crimson Desert
, have issued public apologies for failing to disclose the use of genAI during production after player backlash, following on similar cases for Ubisoft and 11 Bit Studios last year with
Anno 117: Pax Romana
and
The Alters
, respectively.
